verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms BILL Spend & Expense supports creating and managing virtual cards ("Set up budgets, users, & virtual cards", "smart, flexible cards paired with AI-powered spend management") and controlled/categorized transactions, which implies vendor-level card issuance, but none of the docs explicitly describe locking a virtual card to a single vendor/merchant to contain compromise blast radius. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of single-vendor/merchant-lock controls on virtual cards, and any independent/hands-on confirmation of this specific control.
